story_fr: Moderna affiche $389M de revenus au T1 2026, soit près de 4x le T1 2025 ($108M). Les ventes internationales représentent 80% du total, tirées par les contrats hors-US.
story_en: Moderna posted $389M in Q1 2026 revenue, nearly 4x Q1 2025 ($108M), with international sales accounting for 80% of the total.
quote: Total revenues were $389 million for Q1 2026, compared to $108 million for Q1 2025.

story_fr: mCOMBRIAX, premier vaccin combinant grippe et COVID-19 au monde, a recu l'approbation de l'Union europeenne. C'est une avancee strategique majeure pour le pipeline de Moderna.
story_en: mCOMBRIAX, the world's first flu+COVID-19 combination vaccine, received EU approval, marking a major strategic pipeline milestone for Moderna.
signal: Premier vaccin grippe+COVID approuve en UE
quote: mCOMBRIAX received European Commission approval, representing the world's first approved combination influenza and COVID-19 vaccine.

story_fr: Moderna maintient sa guidance 2026 : croissance des revenus jusqu'a +10% par rapport aux $1,9Md de 2025, avec un mix cible 50% US / 50% international.
story_en: Moderna reiterates 2026 guidance of up to 10% revenue growth from 2025's $1.9B base, targeting a balanced 50% US / 50% international mix.
quote: The Company reiterated its 2026 product sales guidance of approximately $1.5 billion to $2.5 billion.

story_fr: Les charges operationnelles continuent de baisser : R&D en recul de 24% et SG&A de 18% au T1 2026 par rapport au T1 2025, confirmant la discipline de reduction des couts.
story_en: Operating expenses continued to decline with R&D down 24% and SG&A down 18% in Q1 2026 vs Q1 2025, confirming the ongoing cost reduction program.
quote: R&D expenses were $649 million in Q1 2026, a decrease of 24% compared to Q1 2025.

story_fr: Un reglement judiciaire de $0,9Md lie au litige avec Pfizer/BioNTech a greve les resultats T1 2026. Le paiement en cash de $950M est attendu au T3 2026, pesant sur la tresorerie.
story_en: A $0.9B non-recurring litigation settlement with Pfizer/BioNTech weighed on Q1 2026 results. A $950M cash payment is due in Q3 2026, pressuring the balance sheet.
quote: Net loss for Q1 2026 includes a $0.9 billion charge related to the litigation settlement with Pfizer and BioNTech.

story_fr: Moderna a lance un essai de Phase 3 de l'intismeran autogene en monotherapie pour le cancer du poumon NSCLC de stade I a haut risque. C'est le premier essai pivot en oncologie sans KEYTRUDA.
story_en: Moderna initiated a Phase 3 trial of intismeran autogene as monotherapy in high-risk Stage I NSCLC — its first pivotal oncology study as a standalone therapy.
quote: Moderna initiated a Phase 3 trial evaluating intismeran autogene as monotherapy in patients with Stage I high-risk NSCLC.
